description: mp20-wyck with a 48-point discrete coordinate grid: kept as a negative result (structure-level accuracy unchanged).
config_text:
# D1, the symmetry geometry decoder, on MP-20.  Identical to mp20_main except for the two switches at the bottom, so a
# D0-vs-D1 difference can only come from the geometry path.  100 epochs.
name: mp20_wyck_bins
description: "D1 + discrete coordinate grid (48 points); differs from mp20_wyck by coordinate_bins only"
output_dir: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_fix/runs/mp20_wyck_bins/out
data:
  table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp20/intake/train.csv
  val_table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp20/intake/val.csv
  id_column: material_id
  cif_column: cif
  properties:
    - {column: formation_energy_per_atom, label: Formation energy, unit: eV/atom, normalize: true}
    - {column: band_gap, label: Band gap, unit: eV, normalize: true}
  max_sites: 20
  site_order: roles
  align_to_prototype: false
model:
  decoder_coordinate_input: zeros
  periodic_encoder: true
  element_features: cgcnn
  decoder_geometry: wyckoff
  coordinate_bins: 48                # <- the only difference from mp20_wyck
training:
  epochs: 100
  batch_size: 128
  learning_rate: 0.001
  seed: 0
  device: cuda
  save_every: 50
  loss_weights: {structure_reconstruction: 1.0, structure_property: 1.0, symmetry: 1.0}   # <- switch 2
